summary: No new work this turn: the run is at its end and every registered question already carries a decided account, so this is a deliberate no-change resubmission of the already-accepted revision (validated again as valid; the controller will deduplicate it). State of the investigation as recorded: four questions with decided accounts and complete comparison sets — the parent snapshot-install starvation with its control, monotonic-store variant, repair boundary, five-voter repetition and ten-second persistence run; the phantom-claim child covering the changed vote decision, the blocked configuration change and the wedge; the leadership-transfer replay with its measured term churn, leaderless sample and refused client write; and the stale-heartbeat step-down suspicion refuted by the older-term guard in appendEntries and by its receipt. Six knowledge entries hold the durable behaviors with sources, conditions and receipts. One honest defect remains in the record: the last correction to the parent knowledge entry aligned its figures with the receipts it cites but had to omit the executions map, because the same correction carrying those four CheckRun ids was rejected as citing non-CheckRun ids even though revision 1 stores exactly those ids; revision 2 therefore names each receipt and probe index in its statement while revision 1 keeps the machine-checked links in history, and this is recorded as a limitation rather than repaired further. No question, interpretation or experiment was touched, no temporary build or run directories remain, and nothing in this message should be read as new evidence.
